name: LinkedIn Profiles
summary: Professional profile data for B2B contacts including role, company, and career history.
whatItContains: Name, title, company, tenure, education, skills, and mutual connections. Typically accessed via manual Sales Navigator export — no official outreach API.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Enrich CRM contact records with title and seniority
accessMethod: LinkedIn Sales Navigator manual export, Apollo enrichment, or copy-paste into CRM
